definitions.auxiliary: Auxiliary has its own 9*(N-K) denominator and fixed weight 0.1.
definitions.clipping: Fraction of rows with total pre-clip norm > 1; coefficient is reconstructed from PyTorch clip formula, not observed parameter delta.
definitions.cosine_scope: Only step 1 and each multiple of 25. Other steps are NA. Zero norm means UNDEFINED.
definitions.gradient: Actual weighted auxiliary backward leaf hooks before accumulation; never a difference of gradient norms.
definitions.independence: Repeat uses independent registered main-stream/teacher-epsilon seeds; fixed START trajectory feedback pool and auxiliary selection are intentionally shared.
definitions.ledger: Every completed metric step is checked against actual BEGIN/RETURN/FAIL. Later calls and inference stages are outside this snapshot.
definitions.primary: FM is the sum of 8 free-coordinate squared errors divided by 9*sum(N-K).
definitions.provenance: Source hashes describe code on disk at diagnostic time. Actual loaded-worker source provenance is in worker snapshots; no claim that a running worker hot-reloaded later edits.
definitions.scope: No DEV or CONFIRM outputs or metrics were read. Losses and gradients are learning diagnostics, not generated-control efficacy or a reason to change the frozen recipe.
definitions.time: Input + update excludes checkpoint I/O, DEV sampling, loading and idle time; concurrent load can affect wall timing.
definitions.time_strata: Primary bins show actual t and coordinate-weighted MSE. Auxiliary t strata compare weighted aux with that step's primary batch, not a same-example loss.
